notes: This contract records a portable C++ TCK check for the official IEEE 1516.1 unconditional attribute ownership divestiture service. The source uses only the standard RTIambassador and FederateAmbassador APIs plus the standard library; the adapter supplies the provider package, FOM, endpoint, and callback configuration. It verifies the immediate unavailability of an If Available request while an attribute is owned, one divestiture resolving a pending regular acquisition and issuing a standard ownership-assumption offer, explicit callback servicing through evokeCallback, exact callback metadata and tag preservation, eligibility filtering for an unpublished candidate, and a subsequent standard If Available acquisition after the attribute becomes unowned. It does not assert provider-specific names, registries, headers, transport, or implementation behavior.

api_surfaces.signature: RTIambassador unconditionalAttributeOwnershipDivestiture, attributeOwnershipAcquisition, attributeOwnershipAcquisitionIfAvailable, and evokeCallback services with FederateAmbassador discovery, requestAttributeOwnershipAssumption, and attributeOwnershipAcquisitionNotification callbacks
